finalText:
Build is clean. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it was trying to reference an undefined variable `retries` instead of pulling it from the `env` object passed in. Changed it to `env.retries || 1` so it reads the caller's value with a sensible fallback.

The three warnings (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) are real quality-of-life improvements you can address when ready, but they don't block the build anymore.
